freeze_dmcontrol_env: use FreezeDmcontrol context manager to freeze and restore a dm_control gym environment state
make_dmcontrol_env_from_str: use DmcontrolEnvHandler.make_env_from_str to create a dm_control gym environment from a domain-task string
get_dmcontrol_env_state: use DmcontrolEnvHandler.get_current_state to retrieve the physics state and elapsed steps from a dm_control env
set_dmcontrol_env_state: use DmcontrolEnvHandler.set_env_state to restore a dm_control environment to a previously saved state tuple
check_dmcontrol_env_type: use DmcontrolEnvHandler.is_correct_env_type to check if a gym environment is a dm_control DMCWrapper
